description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudio SetCaps task, which configures GStreamer caps for a WebAudio player component. It uses Google Test framework to verify correct behavior of setting caps based on different PCM configurations and mime types.

classes.name: WebAudioSetCapsTest
classes.description: Unit test fixture for testing WebAudio SetCaps task behavior, including setup of mock objects and common expectations.

methods.name: getPcmFormat
methods.description: Constructs a string representing the PCM format based on configuration flags such as isFloat, isSigned, sampleSize, and endianness.

methods.name: expectBuildPcmCaps
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating and configuring GstCaps for PCM audio with specific parameters.

methods.name: expectGetCapsStr
methods.description: Sets expectations for converting GstCaps to string and freeing the string.

methods.name: expectSetCaps
methods.description: Sets expectations for retrieving, comparing, and setting GstCaps on the app source element.

methods.name: expectUnref
methods.description: Sets expectations for unreferencing GstCaps objects.

methods.name: expectSetBytesPerSamplePcm
methods.description: Verifies that the expected bytes per sample calculation matches the context's stored value.
